sourcePolicy.visualAuthority: SAGA EDITION - Force Unleashed Campaign Guide.pdf

schemaDelta.principle: Force Unleashed extends the normalized authority only where its published weapons cannot be represented faithfully by Core + KOTOR + Galaxy at War. Authority schema only; no production migration is authorized.

requiredEdits.change: Add attackProfiles[].preparedAttack with activationAction, matures, expires, consumedBy, damageDiceDelta, resourceUnitsOnPreparedAttack, and prohibitsMultiShotAbilities.
why: Bryar pistol and Bryar rifle use a swift action to prime a shot, require a no-attack waiting condition until the next turn, then add +1 weapon die and consume 5 shots.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append preparedAttack:null to every prior attack profile. Do not create prepared states unless a published source establishes them.

requiredEdits.change: Add range.penaltyApplication with vocabulary attack, damage, none, special.
why: CR-1 Blast Cannon uses pistol range bands but applies range penalties to damage rolls instead of attack rolls.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Prior ordinary ranged profiles default to attack; melee profiles use null. Preserve existing Accurate overrides and allowedBands.

requiredEdits.change: Add attackProfiles[].damageComponents[] for simultaneous components that have independent formulas/types/resolution. Keep damageType.mode=and for one damage amount that simultaneously has multiple types.
why: Neuronic Whip deals 2d8 stun damage plus a separate 1d4 slashing damage component.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append damageComponents:[] to prior profiles unless previously certified rules already contain independently rolled components. Do not convert ordinary AND-type damage into multiple rolls.

requiredEdits.change: Add attackProfiles[].firingConstraints {cooldownRounds, firesOnAlternatingRounds, maxShotsPerRound, prohibitsMultiShotAbilities, reloadRequiredAfterEachShot}. This generalizes KOTOR specialRateOfFire.
why: DX-2/DXR-6 fire only once every other round; Flechette Launcher forbids Rapid Shot/multi-shot abilities; E-Web Missile Launcher fires one shot then must reload.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append firingConstraints:null by default. Convert KOTOR Sonic Disruptor specialRateOfFire into this structure without changing its rule; preserve Special ROF as published table data.

requiredEdits.change: Add canonicalStats.defensiveInteractions[] for mechanics governing the weapon object as a defender or defensive implement, distinct from outgoing damageReductionInteraction.
why: Guard Shoto and Lightsaber Pike explicitly retain their own DR against lightsabers; Felucian Skullblade can block lightsaber strikes when Force-imbued.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append defensiveInteractions:[] to prior records, then backfill only source-certified cases such as Core Electrostaff and KOTOR Shockstaff where the existing authority already establishes lightsaber-resistant object DR behavior.

requiredEdits.change: Permit conditionalDamageProfiles entries to use operation=add-dice / area-toggle rather than only replacement damage profiles.
why: CR-1 adds +1d8 only against adjacent targets and gains splash only against nonadjacent targets.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: No change to existing replacement-style conditional damage. Append no new conditional rules unless source-certified.

schemaDelta.sourceQualityRule: Force Unleashed uses the Core/KOTOR Inaccurate definition: cannot fire at Long range. Do not import Galaxy at War's Medium+Long restriction into this book.

bookLocalGuardrails: Do not update a rolling/master weapon authority from this package.
Do not mutate production packs, schema/runtime code, feats, talents, or actors during certification.
Do not create the 4 missing records during this phase.
Repo properties/traits never override the published table or description.
Force Unleashed Inaccurate means Long-range exclusion only; preserve source-specific range semantics.
Do not collapse independently rolled damage components into a single formula.
